links.evidence: PACCAR is our largest customer, accounting for 16 percent of our consolidated net sales in 2022, 15 percent in 2021 and 15 percent in 2020.
Our largest single end customer in 2015 was Apple Inc., accounting for approximately 11 percent of revenue, recognized primarily in our Analog segment.
For 2014, Corning’s sales to Samsung Display Co. Ltd., a customer of our Display Technologies segment, represented 14% of the Company’s consolidated net sales.
Sales to ASUSTeK Computer Inc. accounted for 12% of our total revenue for fiscal year 2017
As of December 31, 2023, a customer of our Semiconductor Test segment, Texas Instruments Inc, accounted for 18% of our accounts receivable balance.
our customer Rite Aid Corporation (including certain of its subsidiaries, “Rite Aid”)
In the private sector we face intense competition from H&R Block, which provides assisted tax preparation services in its stores and a competing software offering called H&R Block At Home.
